19174-the-man-who-rocked-the-earth.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. dy, and Servia, had been devastated. Five million adult male human beings had been exterminated by the machines of war, by disease, and by famine. Ten million had been crippled or invalided. Fifteen million women and children had been rendered widows or orphans. No crops were harvested or sown. The ocean was devoid of sails.

arxiv-2101-12373.title: The Evolutionary Pathways of Disk-, Bulge-, and Halo-dominated Galaxies
arxiv-2101-12373.creator: Min Du, Luis C. Ho, Victor P. Debattista, Annalisa Pillepich, Dylan Nelson, Lars Hernquist, Rainer Weinberger
arxiv-2101-12373.description: Abstract To break the degeneracy among galactic stellar components, we extract kinematic structures using the framework described in Du et al. 2019 ; Du et al. 2020 . For example, the concept of stellar halos is generalized to weakly-rotating structures that are composed of loosely bound stars, which can hence be associated to both disk and elliptical type morphologies.

arxiv-2104-06719.title: Sentence Embeddings by Ensemble Distillation
arxiv-2104-06719.creator: Fredrik Carlsson, Magnus Sahlgren
arxiv-2104-06719.description: Abstract This paper contributes a new State Of The Art (SOTA) for Semantic Textual Similarity (STS). We compare and combine a number of recently proposed sentence embedding methods for STS, and propose a novel and simple ensemble knowledge distillation scheme that improves on previous approaches.

arxiv-2105-00239.title: MRCBert: A Machine Reading Comprehension Approach for Unsupervised Summarization
arxiv-2105-00239.creator: Saurabh Jain, Guokai Tang, Lim Sze Chi
arxiv-2105-00239.description: Abstract When making an online purchase, it becomes important for the customer to read the product reviews carefully and make a decision based on that. However, reviews can be lengthy, may contain repeated, or sometimes irrelevant information that does not help in decision making. In this paper, we introduce MRCBert, a novel unsupervised method to generate summaries from product reviews.

arxiv-2109-03818.title: Online Learning for Cooperative Multi-Player Multi-Armed Bandits
arxiv-2109-03818.creator: William Chang, Mehdi Jafarnia-Jahromi, Rahul Jain
arxiv-2109-03818.description: Abstract We introduce a framework for decentralized online learning for multi-armed bandits (MAB) with multiple cooperative players. The reward obtained by the players in each round depends on the actions taken by all the players. It’s a team setting, and the objective is common. Information asymmetry is what makes the problem interesting and challenging.

arxiv-2309-12726.title: Stokes parameters alone cannot completely characterize the polarization of plane light waves
arxiv-2309-12726.creator: Chun-Fang Li, Zhi-Juan Hu
arxiv-2309-12726.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Chun-Fang Li, Zhi-Juan Hu. It was generally assumed that the Stokes parameters are complete characterization for the state of polarization of a plane light wave so that their counterparts in quantum optics, called the Stokes operators, represent the polarization of photons. Here we show, through analyzing the properties of polarized plane waves in an optically active medium, that the Stokes parameters are not able to completely characterize the state of polarization of a plane wave.

arxiv-2412-04443.title: Diagnosing systematic effects using the inferred initial power spectrum
arxiv-2412-04443.creator: Tristan Hoellinger, Florent Leclercq
arxiv-2412-04443.description: Abstract The next generation of galaxy surveys has the potential to substantially deepen our understanding of the Universe. This potential hinges on our ability to rigorously address systematic uncertainties. Until now, diagnosing systematic effects prior to inferring cosmological parameters has been out of reach in field-based implicit likelihood cosmological inference frameworks.

arxiv-2501-03230.title: Video-of-Thought : Step-by-Step Video Reasoning from Perception to Cognition
arxiv-2501-03230.creator: Hao Fei, Shengqiong Wu, Wei Ji, Hanwang Zhang, Meishan Zhang, Mong Li Lee, Wynne Hsu
arxiv-2501-03230.description: Abstract Existing research of video understanding still struggles to achieve in-depth comprehension and reasoning in complex videos, primarily due to the under-exploration of two key bottlenecks: fine-grained spatial-temporal perceptive understanding and cognitive-level video scene comprehension . This paper bridges the gap by presenting a novel solution.

pmc-10628543.title: Additive effects of light and branching on fruit size and chemical fruit quality of greenhouse tomatoes
pmc-10628543.creator: Martina Paponov, Michel J. Verheul, Petre I. Dobrev, Ivan A. Paponov
pmc-10628543.description: IntroductionGreenhouse tomato growers face the challenge of balancing fruit size and chemical quality traits. This study focused on elucidating the interplay between plant branching and light management on these traits, while maintaining consistent shoot density.MethodsWe evaluated one- and two-shoot plants under varying top light intensities using high-pressure sodium lamps and light-emitting diode (LED) inter-lighting.

pmc-11384947.title: A glia-enriched stem cell 3D model of the human brain mimics the glial-immune neurodegenerative phenotypes of multiple sclerosis
pmc-11384947.creator: Francesca Fagiani, Edoardo Pedrini, Stefano Taverna, Elena Brambilla, Valentina Murtaj, Paola Podini, Francesca Ruffini, Erica Butti, Clarissa Braccia, Annapaola Andolfo, Roberta Magliozzi, Lena Smirnova, Tanja Kuhlmann, Angelo Quattrini, Peter A Calabresi, Daniel S Reich, Gianvito Martino, Paola Pa
pmc-11384947.description: SummaryThe role of central nervous system (CNS) glia in sustaining self-autonomous inflammation and driving clinical progression in multiple sclerosis (MS) is gaining scientific interest. We applied a single transcription factor (SOX10)-based protocol to accelerate oligodendrocyte differentiation from human induced pluripotent stem cell (hiPSC)-derived neural precursor cells, generating self-organizing forebrain organoids.

pmc-11804995.title: Efficacy of Antibiotic Versus Probiotics as Adjuncts to Mechanical Debridement for the Treatment of Peri-Implant Mucositis
pmc-11804995.creator: Sindhu Sudhakar Kumararama, Manali Patil, Bhavna Jha Kukreja, Manjiri Salkar, Shikha Verma, Naina Pattnaik, Lalit Patil
pmc-11804995.description: Background:Peri-implant mucositis, an inflammatory condition affecting the soft tissues surrounding dental implants, is commonly treated with mechanical debridement. The efficacy of adjunctive therapies, such as antibiotics and probiotics, in enhancing treatment outcomes remains a topic of interest.Materials and Methods:A randomized controlled trial was conducted with 60 patients diagnosed with peri-implant mucositis.

pmc-12468745.title: The Relationship Between Prenatal Alcohol Exposure and Infant/Child–Caregiver Attachment: A Scoping Review
pmc-12468745.creator: David J Gilbert, Alan D Price, Penny A Cook, Raja A S Mukherjee, Libor Velíšek
pmc-12468745.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Introduction: Secure infant/child–caregiver attachment is crucial for the development of social and emotional functioning and can affect long-term outcomes, such as adult relationships, but it may also be influenced by prenatal and early childhood risk factors. Children with a history of prenatal alcohol exposure (PAE) have a complex spectrum of strengths and difficulties and often have the additional risk of early life adversity.

pmc-12473824.title: Finite Element Analysis and Experimental Investigation on the Machinability of PMMA/CNT Composites via Nanosectioning
pmc-12473824.creator: Guoyu Fu, Jia Ge, Hao Li, Fengzhen Sun, Weizhou Wu, Alexander Malkin
pmc-12473824.description: In this study, an innovative modeling approach has been proposed to demonstrate the removal mechanisms of Polymethyl Methacrylate (PMMA) reinforced with randomly distributed carbon nanotubes (CNTs) during nanosectioning. The viscoplastic behavior of the matrix polymer was described using the Mulliken–Boyce model and the distribution of the CNTs in the matrix was modeled using the random sequential adsorption (RSA) method.

pmc-12604554.title: Retrieving the intravascular ultrasound catheter in the coronary artery by a gooseneck snare: a case report
pmc-12604554.creator: Hiroshi Fujita, Ken Ito, Kazuomi Ono, Nobuyuki Ohte, F Aaysha Cader, Antonios Karanasos, Minglian Gong, Yaser Alahmad, Silvia Homs Vila, Elaaha Anwari, Su Hnin Hlaing, Deepti Ranganathan
pmc-12604554.description: BackgroundDevice rupture during percutaneous coronary intervention (PCI) is a rare complication. However, devices remaining in the coronary artery must be removed promptly because they can cause occlusion. We report our success in retrieving a fractured intravascular ultrasound (IVUS) catheter using a gooseneck snare.Case summaryA 78-year-old man presented with repeated chest pain on effort.

pmc-13124400.title: Idiopathic mesenteric phlebosclerosis: A case report
pmc-13124400.creator: Jingjing Rao, Yuzheng Xue, Tielong Wu, Yuanyuan Dai, Beilei Xia, Zijun Fan, Haowen Sun, Yingyue Sheng
pmc-13124400.description: Rationale:Idiopathic mesenteric phlebosclerosis (IMP) is a rare disease with unclear etiology and pathogenesis. Although most IMP patients have a long-term history of traditional Chinese herbal medicine use, this article reports a case without such a special medical history, which may provide new insights into the disease’s etiology.
